_source_note: The keyless shared quota is exhausted (confirmed live: every unauthenticated request to googleapis.com/books/v1/volumes returns 429 'Quota exceeded for quota metric Queries'), GOOGLE_BOOKS_API_KEY is required, and this environment has none, so this fixture matches the Google Books API's documented volumes response shape (the same shape the pre-Stage-2 adapter's GBVolume/GBResponse types already assumed) rather than being freshly recorded.
